annotations.title: Read indexed facts about an address

description: Returns every fact the reader has indexed about an address on one chain, as GET /read/:chainId/:address JSON: each fact names its source, carries a permission label of shape (a) to (e), and cites the block, transaction and log index with a command that returns the same log from any RPC. A note reading nothing indexed (blocks X..Y) covers only that block range, and does not mean nothing happened on chain.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, for example 42161 (Arbitrum One) or 8453 (Base)
